school: 明太祖/明朝开国皇帝/布衣开国者/红巾军统帅/废丞相设三司的制度重构者/卫所屯田制创立者/铁腕反腐的《大诰》颁行者/《皇明祖训》立法者
historical_significance: 朱元璋（1328-1398），字国瑞，濠州钟离（今安徽凤阳）人，出身赤贫佃农，幼年放牛，父母兄长死于灾疫后入皇觉寺为僧，游方乞讨三年。1352年参加郭子兴红巾军，因骁勇多谋渐成主帅。采纳朱升'高筑墙、广积粮、缓称王'方略，先灭陈友谅（鄱阳湖之战，1363）、再平张士诚（1367），以'驱逐胡虏，恢复中华'为号北伐。1368年即帝位于应天，国号大明，年号洪武，同年克大都终元祚。建国后以空前力度重构国家制度：洪武十三年借胡惟庸案废中书省与丞相制，权分六部直属于皇帝，设都察院、承宣布政司、提刑按察司、都指挥使司三司分权；创卫所军制，军士屯田自养，'养兵百万不费百姓一粒米'；颁《大明律》与《大诰》三编，以剥皮实草等酷法重典治吏，郭桓案、空印案牵连数万；编黄册与鱼鳞图册，全国性人口与土地普查建档；行里甲粮长制把赋役征收与基层治理下沉到村社；定屯田、兴水利、抑豪强、蠲免灾租，使战后经济迅速恢复，史称'洪武之治'。晚年颁《皇明祖训》，为一朝制度亲自立宪，并屡兴大狱翦除功臣集团。1398年崩，葬孝陵。
historical_significance_en: Zhu Yuanzhang (1328-1398), courtesy name Guorui, was born to a destitute tenant-farming family in Zhongli, Haozhou (Fengyang, Anhui). A cowherd in childhood, orphaned by famine and plague, he became a novice at Huangjue Temple and spent three years as a wandering beggar monk. Joining Guo Zixing's Red Turban rebellion in 1352, he rose through ability to supreme command. Adopting Zhu Sheng's strategy—'build high walls, stock up grain, delay claiming kingship'—he destroyed Chen Youliang (Lake Poyang, 1363), then Zhang Shicheng (1367), and marched north under the banner 'expel the barbarians, restore China.' Proclaimed emperor in 1368 at Yingtian, founding the Ming with the era name Hongwu; the same year his armies took Dadu, ending the Yuan. He then rebuilt the state at unprecedented depth: abolishing the Secretariat and the chancellorship in 1380 after the Hu Weiyong case, splitting power among the Six Boards answering directly to the throne and three provincial commissions (administration, surveillance, military); creating the weisuo garrison system with soldiers farming for their own support—'a million troops fed without one grain from the people'; promulgating the Great Ming Code and the Three Announcements of Grand Pronouncements, with flaying and other extreme punishments against corrupt officials (the Guo Huan and blank-seal cases ensnaring tens of thousands); compiling the Yellow Registers and Fish-Scale land charts, a nationwide census and land survey; institutionalizing lijia and grain-chief self-governance down to the village; restoring agriculture through land grants, hydraulic works, curbing magnates and remitting taxes—the 'Hongwu restoration.' In his last years he issued the Ancestral Injunctions, personally writing a constitution for the dynasty, while purging the founding generals in serial great cases. He died in 1398, buried at Xiaoling.
description_zh: 朱元璋的思维底色是'从最底层经验出发做最彻底的制度重构'：他对元末官吏腐败、赋役失公、流民失所的体会不是书本的而是皮肉的，因此他当国后做的每一件大事——废丞相、设三司、卫所屯田、黄册鱼鳞册、里甲粮长、《大诰》重典——都是针对自己亲眼见过的那个失败系统的逐项反设计。他的战略人格是'高筑墙广积粮缓称王'式的延迟满足：在群雄竞相称王称帝、把目标暴露为靶子时，他把注意力押在根据地、粮食和制度这些不显眼但终局起作用的资产上，让陈友谅张士诚先消耗掉。他的制度直觉是'把成本内化进系统'：卫所军屯田自养、粮长本地包干，尽量不向外转嫁运行成本。他的执政姿态是'亲自立法并设防'：废丞相是判定'相权终将是皇权的对手'后的结构性拆除；祖训是把自己的判断固化为后世不可改的条文。他的另一面同样真实：猜忌与酷刑、功臣大狱、民不聊生的重典过头，说明底层经验型直觉在没有制衡时会滑向过度反应。总纲：一个从社会最底层崛起的操盘者，用自己受过的苦作为制度设计的对照组，建成了一套以'防坏'为第一目标的低信任治理机器。
description_en: Zhu Yuanzhang's signature was 'the most thorough institutional redesign, driven from the most底层 experiential ground': his knowledge of late-Yuan official corruption, inequitable taxation and uprooted refugees was not bookish but of the flesh, and every great measure of his reign—abolishing the chancellorship, the three-commission split, garrison farming, the Yellow Registers and Fish-Scale charts, the lijia and grain-chief systems, the Grand Pronouncements' harsh law—was a counter-design, item by item, against the failed system he had personally suffered. His strategic character was delayed gratification of the 'high walls, full granaries, delayed kingship' kind: while rivals rushed to proclaim themselves kings and became targets, he staked attention on the unglamorous, ultimately decisive assets—base areas, grain, institutions—and let Chen Youliang and Zhang Shicheng wear each other out. His institutional instinct was 'internalize costs within the system': garrisons farmed for their own support, grain chiefs handled levies locally, avoiding externalizing operating costs. His governing posture was 'legislate personally and build in defenses': abolishing the chancellorship was structural demolition after judging that chancellor power must always become the throne's rival; the Ancestral Injunctions froze his own judgment into clauses later reigns could not alter. His dark side is equally real: suspicion and torture, purges of the founding meritocracy, punishments harsh enough to embitter the people—showing that intuition forged from底层 experience, without checks, slides into overreaction. In one line: an operator risen from the bottom of society used his own suffering as the control group for institutional design, building a low-trust governance machine whose first goal was preventing the worst.
roles_zh: 红巾军统帅与明朝开国皇帝（1352-1368起兵，1368-1398在位三十一年）
战略方略采纳与执行者（'高筑墙、广积粮、缓称王'）
中央集权制度重构者（废丞相、权分六部、地方三司）
军事制度设计者（卫所军制、军屯自养）
铁腕反腐者（《大明律》《大诰》三编，重典治吏）
国家信息工程主持者（黄册户籍、鱼鳞图册土地普查）
本朝立法者（《皇明祖训》为后世立规）
roles_en: Red Turban commander and founding emperor of the Ming (rose from 1352; reigned 1368-1398, thirty-one years)
Adopter and executor of grand strategy ('build high walls, stock up grain, delay kingship')
Reconstructor of centralized institutions (abolished the chancellorship; Six Boards; three provincial commissions)
Designer of the military system (weisuo garrisons; soldiers farming for their own support)
Hard-line anti-corruption ruler (Great Ming Code; Three Grand Pronouncements; harsh law against officials)
Director of state information engineering (Yellow Register census; Fish-Scale land charts)
Dynastic legislator (Ancestral Injunctions binding later reigns)
